summary: This is a routine earnings press release and Form 6-K filing by Maris-Tech Ltd. reporting its full-year 2025 financial results. The filing contains no special-situation event—it discloses revenue of $1.34M, net loss of $5.4M, and a $2M financing completed in March 2026. There are no M&A, tender offer, activist, restructuring, or other corporate action items. The disclosure is a standard periodic financial update, not a transformative transaction.
